adb -s 4ae24c72 shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/uidump.xml >/dev/null && adb -s 4ae24c72 pull /sdcard/uidump.xml /tmp/heals-uidump.xml >/dev/null && python3 - <<'PY'
import re
xml=open('/tmp/heals-uidump.xml',encoding='utf-8',errors='ignore').read()
print('len', len(xml))
for m in re.finditer(r'<node[^>]*>', xml):
    tag=m.group(0)
    text=re.search(r'text="([^"]*)"', tag)
    desc=re.search(r'content-desc="([^"]*)"', tag)
    rid=re.search(r'resource-id="([^"]*)"', tag)
    bounds=re.search(r'bounds="([^"]*)"', tag)
    t=text.group(1) if text else ''
    d=desc.group(1) if desc else ''
    r=rid.group(1) if rid else ''
    label=t or d or r
    if label:
        print(f"{label[:120]} | {bounds.group(1) if bounds else ''}")
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
import json, sqlite3, ssl, urllib.request
row = sqlite3.connect('/tmp/RKStorage').execute("SELECT value FROM catalystLocalStorage WHERE key='memberData'").fetchone()[0]
data = json.loads(row)
token = data['accessToken']
user_id = data['entity']['id']
ctx = ssl._create_unverified_context()
url = f'https://heals-patient-gateway-dev.heals.asia/api/v1/health-passport/user/{user_id}'
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={
    'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}',
    'Accept': 'application/json',
    'x-client-id': 'health-passport',
})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=25, context=ctx) as resp:
    body = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    print('http', resp.status, 'top_keys', list(body)[:8] if isinstance(body, dict) else type(body))
payload = body.get('data', body) if isinstance(body, dict) else {}
policies = payload.get('policies') if isinstance(payload, dict) else None
print('policy_count', len(policies or []))
for p in policies or []:
    product = p.get('product') or {}
    plan = p.get('plan') or {}
    benefits = p.get('remainingBenefits')
    print(json.dumps({
        'id': p.get('id'),
        'planId': p.get('planId'),
        'policyName': p.get('policyName'),
        'displayName': product.get('displayName'),
        'productName': product.get('name'),
        'planName': plan.get('name'),
        'expirationDate': p.get('expirationDate'),
        'insuredExpiration': (p.get('insuredItem') or {}).get('expirationDate'),
        'status': p.get('status') or p.get('policyStatus'),
        'remainingBenefits': benefits,
        'benefitKeys': list(benefits) if isinstance(benefits, dict) else None,
    }, ensure_ascii=False))

content.text:
My Pass 现在是空的，因为接口返回的 3 张 plan 都被 `PassScreen` 的过滤条件丢掉了。当前安装版本是 1.2.3，Single Teleconsult 的版本隐藏没有生效。

User1559 的会员数据里实际有这 3 张：

| Plan | 到期 | 剩余次数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Plan | 2031-08-31 | 问诊 0，药物 0 |
| Single Teleconsult（HP-00001207） | 2027-11-02 | 总额 1 次，已完成 1 次，剩余 0 |
| Single Teleconsult（HP-00001208） | 2027-11-02 | 总额 1 次，已完成 1 次，剩余 0 |

过滤写在 `getData` 里。有到期日的 plan 必须同时满足：未过期、名称不是 Basic Plan，并且药物剩余或问诊剩余大于 0。

```116:127:src/screens/pass/pass-screen.tsx
            member_policies: data2.policies.filter((currentValue) => {
              return (
                !currentValue.expirationDate ||
                (new Date(currentValue.expirationDate) > new Date()
                && currentValue.product?.displayName !== "Basic Plan")
                && ((currentValue.remainingBenefits.totalMedicationLimit > 0
                  && currentValue.remainingBenefits.remainingMedicationCount > 0) || (
                    currentValue.remainingBenefits.totalVisitLimit > 0
                    && currentValue.remainingBenefits.remainingVisitLimit > 0
                  ))
              ) && !shouldHideSingleTeleconsultPlan(currentValue);
            })
```

Basic Plan 因为名称被排除。两张已购买的 Single Teleconsult 都还没过期，但 `remainingVisitLimit` 和 `remainingMedicationCount` 都是 0，所以卡片列表变成空数组，轮播不会渲染。这个剩余次数判断是 2025-03-12 加上的，用完的 pass 本来就不会出现在 My Pass。
